text:
mika (support): Customer reported repeated `JSON mode` parse failures during streaming responses, billing spike and a 502 from our gateway. They say some array items arrive partial and some have unexpected keys. embedding: req id `req_9a7b`

mika (support): customer excerpt: 
```
> Received chunk: '{"order_id":123, "items":[{"id":"a1","qty":2},{"qty":3,"id":"a2","metadata":{"color":"red","unexpected_field":"x"}}'
> next chunk: '], "customer": {"id": 42}}'
```

mika (support): Parser fails because of interleaved partial objects and extra nested key `unexpected_field`. They hit retries and our usage doubled. Billing flagged it as potential anomaly.

derek (eng-runtime): looking. can you paste the original request headers and whether `stream=true` was set?

mika (support): raw request: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-customer
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "open-llama-stream-v2",
  "json_mode": true,
  "stream": true,
  "prompt": "render orders as JSON array of items",
  "max_tokens": 1024
}
```

mika (support): they also sent `x-customer-retries: 3`.

derek (eng-runtime): repro steps I ran locally: toggled `stream=true` and used a deterministic tokenizer seed. I can reproduce partial item boundaries where the model emits a nested object across chunks, and the model sometimes injects an extra key (`unexpected_field`) in the middle of an object. That breaks our strict per-item JSON decoder which assumes each item starts with `{` and closes before the next.

derek (eng-runtime): sample streaming transcript I captured: 
```
chunk1: {"items":[{"id":"a1","qty":2},
chunk2: {"id":"a2","qty":3,"metadata":{"color":"red","unexpected_field":"x"}},
chunk3: {"note":"end"}]}
```

derek (eng-runtime): Parser state machine fails when the `}` that closes metadata arrives in a different chunk than the closing `}` for the item. We then treat trailing commas/newlines as malformed JSON.

sophia (ml-inference): model-side notes: we occasionally get tokenization splits inside JSON strings and the model can output auxiliary keys when prompted loosely. For streaming, sequence length & sampling temp interact to produce the ordering variance.

mika (support): customer complains: 1) their client library choked on invalid JSON and retried, 2) they were double-billed for retries, 3) latency from gateway increased with backoff.

billing-bot: Alert: unusual usage detected for customer org `org_773` — 2.1x baseline, flagged for manual review.

derek (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation: advise customer to set `stream=false` or use our `json_mode: "chunked-safe"` workaround that buffers until a top-level item boundary detected. Sending canned snippet: 
```
{"json_mode":"chunked-safe"}
```

mika (support): sent workaround and asked for request ids and SDK version. Customer replied with `req_9a7b`, node-sdk v1.4.2.

derek (eng-runtime): root cause: schema assumptions + strict streaming parser + model emission of extra keys when sampling. We'll add tolerant parsing (buffer partial nested objects until balanced braces) and a feature gate to emit per-item boundary tokens in model prompts.

derek (eng-runtime): proposed short-term fix: patch parser to hold incomplete nested objects across chunks and ignore unknown keys under a `metadata` allowlist. This avoids hard failures but we'll log any tolerated anomalies for auditing.

sophia (ml-inference): long-term: update prompt templates to coax stable keys, add a validation pass in the runtime that canonicalizes field ordering for array items to prevent ordering assumptions from breaking downstream SDKs. Also evaluate deterministic decoding at low temp for structured outputs.

mika (support): customer asked for a retro and charge reversal. I escalated to billing and legal, sent provisional credit offer pending root cause.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-885 for reversal review.

oncall-bot: Incident task created: INC-2024-713, assignee @derek (eng-runtime), priority P2.

derek (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR for the tolerant buffer and add a flag `strict_json_mode=true|false`. Will include unit tests simulating chunk splits and nested extra keys. ETA ~ 48h.

mika (support): thanks — customer wants weekly status updates. I'll follow up and include them on the thread. :thumbsup:

sophia (ml-inference): FYI I'll add a small eval job to our CI that streams 10k structured-output prompts at sampling temps 0.0, 0.2, 0.6 to measure downstream parse error rate.

derek (eng-runtime): also noting this could be exploited by noisy clients to create billing spikes; we should rate-limit retries based on parse error signature.

mika (support): copying customer: we'll roll out a safe parser patch, provide credit, and follow up weekly. closing on customer side once they validate.

mika (support): end.
